description: Morphe patches for BitChord 1.8.1: play music from your own Telegram channels, with lossless quality, album covers and track name fixes. Uses your own Telegram account; doesn't unlock premium features.

patches.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

options.description: The app name on your home screen, up to 80 characters. Leave blank for Bitchord+. A name containing Telegram must include Unofficial Telegram.

patches.name: Unofficial Telegram music
patches.description: Search and play audio from your own Telegram channels, right on your phone. Android 8 or newer.

options.description: Leave at 0 and enter your API ID in the app after installing.
Leave empty and enter your API hash in the app after installing.

release_notes:
- **The Telegram page in 14 languages:** Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, Bengali, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Korean and Indonesian. It follows your phone's language, and Arabic and Urdu read right to left.
- **Dolby audio:** Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus and Dolby Atmos files (.ac3, .ec3, and Dolby in .m4a, .mp4, .mka) play and show as **Dolby Atmos**, **DD+ 5.1** and so on in the format legend. Atmos files get BitChord's own Dolby Atmos badge. **Hide Dolby files this phone can't play** hides AC-4 files on phones without a decoder.
- **Fixed Copy into main channel showing no progress.** The index went through one chat at a time, so the community channels and your main channel waited behind any large music chat. Your main channel is now indexed first and the other chats take turns. Copying starts from each community channel once it's indexed, and the status line says what it's waiting for and how far along it is.
- A copy Telegram refuses is retried three times, ten minutes apart, with the reason shown, before it's skipped.
- **Community channels** no longer lists private channels you own.
- Your main channel is indexed as soon as you choose it, not only while copying.

Works with BitChord **1.8.1**. Patch with **both** patches and the same Morphe signing key to update over your current Bitchord+.
